boundary_reason: Stable policy selection of 80 revisions, no source-identity truncation. Source verification is not semantic completion.

entries.source: Call upon the forces of nature to cure your body of %d poisons and diseases.
entries.target: 召唤自然的力量治愈你的身体，移除 %d 个毒素和疫病不良效果。

entries.source: Amidst this chaos wanders one class of rogue that has learned to take by force rather than subterfuge. With refined techniques, agile feats and brawn-backed blades the Marauder seeks out his targets and removes them by the most direct methods. He uses dual weapons backed by advanced combat training to become highly effective in battle, and he is unafraid to use the dirtiest tactics when the odds are against him.
entries.target: 在这混乱之中诞生了一种特殊的盗贼，他们擅于正面交锋而不是使用诡计。拥有精准特技、灵巧步伐和锋利刀刃的掠夺者搜寻他的目标并直接消灭他们。他们通过高等战斗训练使双持武器更加有效，情形不利时他们不会忌讳使用肮脏的手段取得胜利。

entries.source: Releases poisonous spores at the target, doing %d%% damage and poisoning it.
entries.target: 向目标喷射毒性孢子，造成 %d%% 伤害并使其中毒。

entries.source:
Use an adjacent friend or foe as a springboard, vaulting over them to another tile within range.
		This maneuver grants you a burst of speed from your momentum, allowing you run %d%% faster (movement speed bonus) in the same direction you vaulted for 3 turns.
		The increased speed ends if you change directions or stop moving.
entries.target:
利用相邻的友军或敌人作为跳板，从他们头上跳入技能范围内的另外一格中。
		这个伎俩使你借助弹跳的力量提高你的速度，让你在跳跃的方向上的移动速度增加 %d%% 三回合。
		如果你改变方向或者停止移动，速度加成将会消失。
通用 增加奥术伤害

entries.source: grant you two additional generic talent points
entries.target: 获得额外2点通用技能点数

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#*It eats it all and looks happy. After a while it strolls away. Somehow you feel you have not seen the last of it.*#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*它全部吃光了，看起来很开心。过了一会，它溜达着离开了。不知为何，你感觉你还会再见到它。*#WHITE#
已杀死 %d/%d 个恶魔子嗣。

entries.source:
You seek balance between fire and cold based on your current Psi level.
		You blast your foes with %0.1f Fire damage based on your current Psi, %0.1f Cold damage based on your max Psi minus your current Psi, in a radius %d ball.
		This sets your current Psi to half of your maximum Psi.
		The damage scales with your Mindpower.
entries.target:
根据当前灵能值，你在火焰和寒冷之间寻求平衡。
		你轰击敌人，根据当前灵能值造成 %0.1f 火焰伤害，并根据灵能值上限与当前值之差造成 %0.1f 寒冷伤害，爆炸半径为 %d 格。
		这个技能会使你当前的灵能值变为上限的一半。
		伤害受精神强度加成。

entries.source: Three elixirs stand between me and acceptance into the Brotherhood of Alchemists, unless I've been through that already. I'm never quite sure. But I think that's the case. Bring me the ingredients.
entries.target: 在我和被炼金术士兄弟会接纳之间还隔着三瓶药剂——除非我已经经历过这一切了。我从来都不太确定。但我猜情况就是这样。去把原料给我找来。

entries.source: Oh yes, I think we could arrange that. Shadow, would it be possible to create a portal for her?
entries.target: 当然可以，我相信我们能做到。堡垒之影，能为她制造一个传送门吗？

entries.source: Found the Blood of Life and the four unique inscriptions: Primal Infusion, Infusion of Wild Growth, Rune of Reflection and Rune of the Rift.
entries.target: 获得生命之血与四种特殊刻印：原初纹身，野性生长纹身，反射符文，时空裂缝符文。

entries.source: He eyes you and your belongings, then suddenly vanishes... strange, why is your pack lighter?
entries.target: 他盯着你和你的背包，然后突然消失不见……好奇怪，你的背包似乎轻了许多？

entries.source:
Sixth time this week stuck guarding at the stash. And for what? Just a little fun! 

Almost miss being at the farm sometimes. At least there I wasn't able to screw anything up. Wonder if they would take me back knowing what I've been doing with my life...
entries.target:
这已经是这周第六次呆在这里守卫了。我得到了什么？只得到了一点小乐子！

好吧，我都开始怀念在农场里的日子了。至少那时候我不会把事情搞砸。真不知道如果他们知道我做了什么之后，是否还会把我带回去……

entries.source: Crafted for a warlord who wanted to keep his subjects under a stralite grip. Dark thoughts went into the making of these gauntlets, literally.
entries.target: 一位军阀为将臣民牢牢掌控于斯莱特之掌中而打造了这副手套。制作过程中确实注入了黑暗的思想。

entries.source:
#GOLD#Vim#LAST#
Vim represents the amount of life energy you control. Each corruption talent requires some.
It does not regenerate naturally; you need to drain it from yourself or your victims.
Each time you kill a creature you gain 30% of your Willpower + 1 as Vim.  This value is multiplied by half the rank of the creature.
If you can't pay for the Vim cost of a talent you may instead pay with life at a rate of 200% of the Vim cost.
entries.target:
#GOLD#活力#LAST#
活力是你控制的生命能量。施放堕落系法术需要消耗活力值。
活力值不会自动回复，你需要从你自身和你的目标身上吸取。
每杀死一个生物可以吸收意志属性30%+1的活力值。该数值乘以生物分级的一半。
如果你无法支付使用一个技能的活力值，你可以改为支付活力值消耗200%的生命值。

entries.source: High Sun Paladin Aeryn appears next to you!
entries.target: 高阶太阳骑士艾琳在你的身边出现了！

entries.source: A malevolent skeleton archmage that has taken control of the Dreadfell since the Master's demise.
entries.target: 一位邪恶的骷髅法师，自从领主大人死后，他便继承了恐惧王座。

entries.source:
Yes! Thanks to you this place is now free from the corruption. I will stay on this island to study the magical aura, and as promised I can make you powerful amulets.
Bring me a an amulet and two different gems and I will turn them into a powerful amulet, though the original properties of the amulet will be lost.
I will not make you pay a fee for it since you helped me so much, but I am afraid the ritual requires a gold plating. This should be equal to about 1000 gold pieces.
entries.target:
对！感谢你让这个地方从腐化中脱离了出来。我会留在这个岛上学习魔法光环，我会遵守我的诺言帮你制作一条强力的项链。
给我带来一条项链还有两颗不同的宝石，我会利用它们制作一条强力的项链。
你帮了我那么多，这次我不收任何费用。不过制作过程中需要镀金工艺，这大约得花费 1000 金币，而且项链原本的属性将不复存在。

entries.source: Digs out all terrain in between three and six radius %d balls.
entries.target: 在三到六个半径 %d 范围的圆里摧毁所有地形。

entries.source: Bind the brilliant powers into glyphs to trap your foes.
entries.target: 将璀璨之力束入符文，困住敌人。
调试模式 -- 触发事件

entries.source:
Cut into an enemy and twist the blade, dealing %d%% damage and increasing the intensity of their existing bleed effects by %d%%.

Each point in Bloodstained talents reduces the amount of damage you take from bleed effects by 2%%
entries.target:
将刀锋切入敌人的身体然后旋转，造成 %d%% 伤害并增加其流血强度 %d%%。

每一点血染系技能使你受到的流血伤害减少2%%。

entries.source: I want to take direct control.
Some giant wraps would make you feel great.
entries.target: 集齐巨人的裹腕会让你感觉棒极了。

entries.source: asked the Eidolon to let %s die in peace
entries.target: 请求艾德隆让 %s 安息。

entries.source: Perhaps you should explore it and find the truth, and the treasures, for yourself!
entries.target: 也许你应该去那里一探究竟，顺便可以找到埋藏在那里的财宝！

entries.source:
Learn to lay Warp Mines in a radius of 1.  Warp Mines teleport targets that trigger them either toward you or away from you depending on the type of mine used and inflict %0.2f physical and %0.2f temporal (warp) damage.
		The mines are hidden traps (%d detection and %d disarm power based on your Magic), last for %d turns, and each have a ten turn cooldown.
		Investing in this talent improves the range of all Spacetime Folding talents and the damage caused by your Warp Mines will improve with your Spellpower.
		
		Current Spacetime Folding Range: %d
entries.target:
学会在半径 1 的范围内埋设时空地雷，造成 %0.2f 物理和 %0.2f 时空伤害。
		时空地雷能将敌人传送，到你身边或者传到远处。
		地雷是隐藏的陷阱（ %d 侦查强度 %d 解除强度基于魔法），持续 %d 回合，有 10 回合冷却时间。
		在该技能上投入点数能增加时空折叠系技能的半径。
		地雷伤害受法术强度加成。

		当前半径：%d

entries.source: Two large pieces of leather designed to be wrapped about the hands and the forearms.  This particular pair of wraps has been enchanted, imparting the wearer with great strength.
entries.target: 两大块皮革被设计成包裹手和前臂。这副独特的护手经过了附魔，可给予穿戴者巨大的力量。

entries.source: A scrawny Elven scribe, looking bewildered at his surroundings.
entries.target: 一个瘦骨嶙峋的精灵书记员，他困惑地看着周围的环境。

entries.source: You have learned how to create Poison Gas traps!
entries.target: 你学会了如何制作毒气陷阱！

entries.source:
You surround yourself with a radius %d distortion of gravity, knocking back and dealing %0.2f physical damage to all creatures inside it.  The effect lasts %d turns.  Deals 50%% extra damage to pinned targets, in addition to the knockback.
		The blast wave may hit targets more then once, depending on the radius and the knockback effect.
		The damage will scale with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
你用 %d 码半径范围的重力吸收光环围绕自己，击退所有单位并造成 %0.2f 物理伤害。此效果持续 %d 回合。对定身状态目标额外造成 50%% 伤害。
		这股爆炸性冲击波可能会对目标造成多次伤害，这取决于攻击半径和击退效果。
		伤害受法术强度加成。
